Part C — Transport Rate Setup

Verified in the real signed-in development application on 5 October 2026. Part D was not started. No production changes were applied.

Results

  • Shared estimator formula: distance × 2 × rate ÷ payload. Four estimator call sites use the shared helper.
  • 950/km/load × 12 km one way × 2 = ₹22,800/trip; ÷ 30 MT = ₹760/MT.
  • Payload zero: required warning, blank ₹/MT, Save disabled. Direct API attempt also rejected with HTTP 400.
  • Lead zero: both prices blank. Untouched NULL setups retain the existing flat-rate controls.
  • Save and reload restored all three inputs. The temporary verification card was deleted afterward.
  • All 11 original rate-card rows in both development targets retained every existing field; the three added fields remained NULL. NARASIMHULU's five original cards matched the before API snapshot exactly, including timestamps.
  • Estimator DBM example before / after: transport ₹760 / ₹760 per MT; final laid ₹4,730 / ₹4,730 per MT. Entire calculated result matched.
  • 47 focused tests passed; production build passed.

Actual Publish preview

ALTER TABLE "vendor_rate_cards" ADD COLUMN "lead_distance_km" real;
ALTER TABLE "vendor_rate_cards" ADD COLUMN "payload_mt" real;
ALTER TABLE "vendor_rate_cards" ADD COLUMN "rate_per_km" real;

No drops, renames, NOT NULL changes, defaults, truncations or warnings. Applied only to the two development targets; production remains pending the user's Publish action.

Existing bill → standing-rate write-back (unchanged)

Save/Update submits positive, non-generated bill rows to the bulk rate-card endpoint after validation. A matching normalized vendor/key/category/unit is overwritten, without a separate warning. The first duplicate key/category wins. Server authorization requires Create on vendor_masters_manage or admin_settings (admin/owner bypass). The request is unawaited and its errors are hidden; it may succeed even if the bill save fails. This behavior was reported, not changed. Omitting new setup fields does not erase them.
